description: Answer open-web questions with a grounded response and citation URLs (news, reference sites, documentation). Use this for non-Studocu sources. For Studocu study documents, lecture notes, summaries, or course materials, use search-documents instead. Competitor study-material domains are excluded from results.

query.description: Open-web question or search prompt (external sources only). For Studocu study documents, lecture notes, or course materials use search-documents instead.

site.description: Optional domain filter, e.g. "rijksoverheid.nl". Restricts search to that site when supported.

name: search-web

citations.description: Sources used for the answer, with title, URL, and domain.

text.description: Grounded answer text, including inline citation links when present.

title: Web Search
